rmt-2011-geo-01.prompt: Jeffrey starts out at $(0,0)$ facing in some direction. Each second, Jeffrey walks forward 1 unit, and then turns counterclockwise by $45^\circ$. When Jeffrey returns to his starting point, what is the area of the shape he has made?

rmt-2011-geo-09.prompt: Given $\triangle ABC$. Let $A'$ lie on $BC$ such that $BA'=\frac14A'C$, $B'$ lie on $AC$ such that $AB'=B'C$, and $C'$ lie on $AB$ such that $2AC'=BC'$. Let $D$ be the point of intersection between $AA'$ and $CC'$, $E$ the point of intersection between $AA'$ and $BB'$, and $F$ the point of intersection between $BB'$ and $CC'$. What is $\dfrac{\text{area}(\triangle DEF)}{\text{area}(\triangle ABC)}$?
